rival.feature.name: Rival personalities
rival.feature.desc: Rivals get a character, notice your moves and answer them.
rival.param.randomCharacters.label: Random characters
rival.param.randomCharacters.tooltip: When a new game starts, the characters are shuffled among the companies. Switch it on before starting a new game: a game in progress keeps its assignments.
rival.param.hiddenCharacters.label: Hidden characters
rival.param.hiddenCharacters.tooltip: A rival's character is unknown until it answers one of your moves or its attitude to you reaches "Respect". Switch it off to see the characters at once.
rival.param.intelFog.label: Intelligence fog
rival.param.intelFog.tooltip: Market shares and performance of the rivals are shown roughly on the intelligence panel, with the sign "≈".
rival.param.forceReactions.label: Debug: instant reactions
rival.param.forceReactions.tooltip: Debug build only: the chance of a reaction is 100 %, the warning is 1 day, there is no grace period.
rival.archetype.hegemon.name: Hegemon
rival.archetype.hegemon.desc: Market leader. Defends its share with counter-launches and exclusive OEM deals.
rival.archetype.price_warrior.name: Price Warrior
rival.archetype.price_warrior.desc: Cheap launches. Answers threats with price cuts.
rival.archetype.fast_follower.name: Fast Follower
rival.archetype.fast_follower.desc: Quickly copies other people's successful products and answers every strong launch with a new one of its own.
rival.archetype.engineer.name: Engineering House
rival.archetype.engineer.desc: Bets on performance and research and does not hurry to release. Poaches engineers from whoever outpaced it in technology.
rival.archetype.conservative.name: Conservative
rival.archetype.conservative.desc: Cautious and peaceful. Answers rarely and mildly, prefers to recall a faulty batch.
rival.archetype.niche_specialist.name: Niche Specialist
rival.archetype.niche_specialist.desc: Sticks to its niche and efficient designs. Defends it with price.
rival.archetype.foundry_partner.name: Foundry Partner
rival.archetype.foundry_partner.desc: Manufactures other people's processors and does not fight. The warmer the relations, the better its terms.
rival.event.priceCut.title: {0} cuts prices
rival.event.priceCut.text: A rival is cutting prices to keep its buyers. When the period ends, prices return to normal.
rival.event.priceCut.cause: A reply to your moves on the market.
rival.event.counterLaunch.title: {0} prepares a counter processor
rival.event.counterLaunch.text: The rival's engineers were moved to answer your processor. Expect a new product in the coming months.
rival.event.counterLaunch.cause: A reply to your strong launch.
rival.event.oemPush.title: {0} pushes into the OEM market
rival.event.oemPush.text: The rival is in closed talks with OEM makers. Your tender odds may drop.
rival.event.oemPush.cause: A reply to your success in tenders and on the market.
rival.event.smear.title: {0} smears your company
rival.event.smear.text: A competitor leaked damaging rumours to the press. Your reputation drops.
rival.event.smear.cause: A reply to your growing market share.
rival.poach.title: {0} is poaching your engineers
rival.poach.body: Your lead engineers got an offer from {0}. Keeping them will cost {1}.
rival.poach.cause: A reply to your technology lead.
rival.mail.intel.subject: Intel: {0}
rival.mail.intel.priceCut: Sources inside {0} report a price cut being prepared in the {1} segment. Expected within {2} wk.
rival.mail.intel.counterLaunch: {0} is moving engineers to answer your {1} processor. The work should start within {2} wk; expect a new product in the coming months.
rival.mail.intel.oemPush: {0} is in closed talks with OEM makers. Your tender odds may drop. Expected within {2} wk.
rival.mail.intel.poach: Sources say {0} has an eye on your lead engineers. An offer to them may come within {2} wk.
rival.mail.intel.smear: {0} is preparing a campaign against your reputation. Expected within {2} wk.
rival.mail.counter.subject: Counter-strike: {0}
rival.mail.counterLaunchDone: {0} released {1} in response to your launch in the {2} segment.
rival.notify.started.counterLaunch: {0} is preparing a counter-processor in the {1} segment
rival.notify.started.oemPush: {0} is pushing on the OEM market: its tender odds went up
rival.notify.started.poach: {0} poached some of your engineers: research is slower
rival.notify.started.smear: {0} is smearing your company: reputation is down
rival.fx.counterLaunch: {3}: counter-launch in the {4} segment (design rating x{5}, research funding x{6})
rival.mail.partner.subject: Partnership offer from {0}
rival.mail.partner.body: Your foundry partner is ready to talk terms.
rival.hub.title: Rivals
rival.hub.intro: The characters, attitudes and plans of your rivals are gathered in the intelligence window.
rival.window.title: Intel: Rivals
rival.window.attitudeTip: The rival's attitude towards you, from -100 to +100. It grows with joint contracts and falls with your strong launches, low prices and broken deals. Over time it returns to the level usual for the rival's character.
rival.window.discountHint: The foundry partner offers a markup discount of up to {0} pp
rival.window.discountNone: The foundry partner gives no markup discount yet: it needs a warmer attitude
rival.history.hostileDeal: you took a company over against its will
rival.trigger.OemLoss: your win in an OEM tender
rival.debug.title: Debug: rival reactions
rival.debug.hint: Debug build only. Pick a rival and a type of reaction: it is planned at once and carried out one day after the intel mail is delivered.
rival.debug.notReady: The game is not ready yet: open this page in a game in progress.
